name: pr-lifecycle
description: /pr-gate across the PR lifecycle: pre-PR Codex rounds, then the repository's own post-PR reviews, under one review budget and one record, with a live progress pane.

allowanceStandard.title: Review rounds, standard changes
allowanceStandard.description: Discretionary review rounds one lifecycle may complete on a standard change, before and after the PR opens together, advisory rounds included. The protected post-PR rounds do not count. Replaces maxRounds, which is read when this is unset. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

allowanceHigh.title: Review rounds, high blast-radius changes
allowanceHigh.description: The same allowance for a high blast-radius change. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

allowanceLight.title: Review rounds, light lane
allowanceLight.description: The same allowance for a branch on the light lane (lightBranches), unless its blast radius is high: then it takes the full lane and allowanceHigh. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

bases.title: Gated base branches
bases.description: Comma-separated base branches whose PRs must pass the gate first. The first one is the default base.

enforce.title: Block ungated PRs
enforce.description: Deny `gh pr create` (and the GitHub MCP create-PR tool) to a gated base until the gate has finished for the current HEAD, and start the gate when one is denied.

enforceMerge.title: Hold merges until the lifecycle is done
enforceMerge.description: Deny merging a PR to a gated base (gh, gh api, GitHub MCP tools) until its lifecycle review is complete for the PR's current head, or the person waived it.

fixer.title: Who fixes findings
fixer.description: main sends each round's findings back to the main agent; subagent hands them to a fresh sub-agent.

fixReview.title: Review the fix before the next round
fixReview.description: A separate sub-agent checks the fix commits before Codex sees them again. auto does this only for high blast-radius changes.

onExhausted.title: After the last round without agreement
onExhausted.description: open-pr opens the PR anyway when the pre-PR allowance is spent (never with an open security P1); stop leaves it held for a person's decision. Either way the post-PR lifecycle still runs, and merging stays held. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

openPr.title: Ask the main agent to open the PR
openPr.description: When the gate finishes, prompt the main agent to push and open the PR following the repository's own rules.

highRiskPaths.title: High blast-radius paths
highRiskPaths.description: A regular expression over changed file paths. A match raises the tier to high: Codex challenge mode runs in parallel with the review, on codexModelHigh at highEffort, and fixes are reviewed before the next round. A submodule pointer to a commit already on that submodule's origin/main or origin/dev is not counted. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

reviewEffort.title: Codex effort, standard changes
reviewEffort.description: The reasoning effort Codex starts at on a standard change. A high blast-radius change (highRiskPaths, or a large diff) starts at highEffort, a light-lane branch at lightEffort. When Codex times out, the round reruns one level lower, down to low; the next run on that branch starts a level below where the timed-out one ended. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

lightBranches.title: Light-lane branches
lightBranches.description: A regular expression over the branch name. A matching branch gets one Codex round and no advisory rounds; whatever Codex raises goes to the pull request's own review. A pointer bump, version-only bump or already-landed commits pass without Codex on any branch. Empty turns the light lane off. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

lightEffort.title: Codex effort, light-lane branches
lightEffort.description: The effort Codex starts at on a light-lane branch that is not high blast radius. A high blast-radius change starts at highEffort. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

highEffort.title: Codex effort, high blast-radius changes
highEffort.description: The effort Codex starts at on a high blast-radius change (highRiskPaths, or a large diff), light lane or not. A timeout steps it down as for the other tiers. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

rereviewEffort.title: Codex effort, re-reviews
rereviewEffort.description: The effort of every Codex dispatch after the first completed round Codex ran in: later rounds, the consult of earlier rebuttals and fixes, the post-PR rebuttal check, and the post-PR Codex fallback. Never above the tier's starting effort. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

codexModel.title: Codex model, standard and light-lane changes
codexModel.description: The Codex model the gate names to the gstack /codex skill (--model, GSTACK_CODEX_MODEL) on a change that is not high blast radius. Empty names none, so gstack's own order applies (GSTACK_CODEX_MODEL, then Codex config.toml). Every Codex step uses it, the post-PR rebuttal check included. A model gstack cannot use, or a step that reports another model, stops the round; it never falls back to another. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

codexModelHigh.title: Codex model, high blast-radius changes
codexModelHigh.description: The Codex model the gate names on a high blast-radius change. Empty names none, so gstack's own order applies. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

runnerModel.title: Claude model, Codex runners
runnerModel.description: The Claude model of the sub-agents that run Codex: the review, the challenge and the post-PR rebuttal check. An alias (sonnet, opus, haiku) or a full id; empty inherits the session's model. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

fixAgentModel.title: Claude model, fixer and fix reviewer
fixAgentModel.description: The Claude model of the fix sub-agent (fixer: subagent) and the sub-agent that reviews a fix. An alias or a full id; empty inherits the session's model. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

stepTimeoutMinutes.title: Step timeout (minutes)
stepTimeoutMinutes.description: How long one agent step may run before the gate stops with an error.

routineRoundMinutes.title: Routine round timebox (minutes)
routineRoundMinutes.description: The active time a routine round should take. Going over is shown and recorded, not failed; stepTimeoutMinutes is the hard limit.

waitCapMinutes.title: Reviewer wait cap (minutes)
waitCapMinutes.description: The longest a post-PR round waits for reviewers before it carries on with what arrived. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.

quietMinutes.title: Quiet period (minutes)
quietMinutes.description: Without a roster file, collection ends once checks are done and no new feedback arrived for this long. A repository's .github/pr-gate.json on the base can set its own.
